samples.retention_note: Selected required metrics transcribed from the first tool output; later samples are parsed from retained stdout.

sql.query: BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '5s'; SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '500ms'; SET LOCAL application_name = 'ce1_ce100_capacity'; SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at, current_user AS operator, current_setting('max_connections')::int AS max_connections, current_setting('track_io_timing') AS track_io_timing, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()) AS client_connections_excluding_probe, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend' AND state = 'active' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()) AS active_excluding_probe, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend' AND wait_event_type = 'Lock' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()) AS waiting_for_lock_excluding_probe, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend' AND state = 'idle in transaction' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()) AS idle_in_transaction_excluding_probe, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend' AND cardinality(pg_blocking_pids(pid)) > 0 AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()) AS blocked_client_sessions, (SELECT deadlocks FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname=current_database()) AS deadlocks, (SELECT stats_reset FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname=current_database()) AS stats_reset; ROLLBACK;
